_comment: Seed specs for the release smoke scan (ci/smoke-archive.sh): one blocking identity per lane of ci/smoke/repo, each with no bound in the fixture, so every lane must decide a `violates` site. Test-grade, not the production corpus.

apis.rationale: Do blocks until the response headers arrive; a client Timeout or a request context deadline bounds it
requests.get blocks until the response completes; the bound is the per-call timeout= argument
curl_easy_perform blocks until the transfer completes and is unbounded unless CURLOPT_TIMEOUT(_MS) was set on the handle
setopt configures the handle and performs no I/O

configs.rationale: net/http.Client is bounded end to end only when Timeout is set
